name: Chain Switch
description: A timed logic actor that monitors an activation variable and performs configured actions when its countdown expires.

fields.name: Disappear on Completion
fields.description: Causes the actor to disappear in a puff of smoke when the countdown expires.

fields.name: Target Variable Action
fields.description: Determines how the target room-local variable is changed when the countdown expires.

fields.name: Target Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable to set or clear when the countdown expires.

fields.name: Activation Action
fields.description: Determines how the activation state is changed when the countdown expires.

fields.name: Activation Variable
fields.description: The room-local variable monitored to start the countdown.
